news.title: Nvidia to invest up to $3.2 billion in Corning as part of massive optical fiber deal with 3 new factories focused on AI
news.description: Corning is opening three new advanced manufacturing plants in the U.S. dedicated entirely to optical technologies for Nvidia.

news.title: Apollo CEO Rowan warns of market correction, slams ‘egregious’ practices at rival insurers
news.description: Apollo CEO Marc Rowan warned that markets face an elevated risk of unexpected shocks, saying he is positioning the firm defensively for an expected correction.

news.title: FanDuel CEO Amy Howe is out after five years at the sportsbook
news.description: Howe has overseen FanDuel during a time of dramatic expansion in sports gambling and as prediction markets have exploded in popularity.
